notes.title: About the experience version of the game, some UI and some problems are fixed
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for playing the game
In response to questions from community posts about the game, we started to change the presentation of some of the UI to make it easier for players to understand the game.

1.0: Adjusted the main menu of the UI (now Chinese and English will not be displayed in the same interface)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348487/3643ef87fb5bd1061af1269dae1ceb61c5e4c2c3.png[/img]


2.0: Adjusted the key feedback of the QTE Wave dance board and optimized the UI display in the pre-preparation stage of QTE

notes.title: 🌊 "Surf Dance" Steam release & Free experience version is now available! 🌊
notes.notes:
Dear players, are you ready to join a group of cute little characters to step on the waves and start a relaxing and exciting surfing race?

"Surf Dance" - a 3D high-speed platform jumping and running game with QTE as the core of leisure time racing rhythm, today officially released the release notice, free experience version simultaneously on Steam!



🌟 Game features Quick overview:



🦦 Support for custom MOD roles (using UE engine)

MOD making tutorial:
[previewyoutube=MhPfhWoXDf8;full][/previewyoutube]



⏱️Surfing challenge! In an infinite number of randomly arranged levels, refresh time, distance, score, QTE and even the highest number of failures time after time!



🏄 Smooth operation, easy to jump! Two-stage jump, extreme sprint, hot dance QTE - silky move to conquer all platforms, feel the extreme speed rhythm of the wave dance pleasure!



🌴 relaxed atmosphere! The sun, the beach, the coconut grove and the sound of the waves, with the cheerful background music, let you relax in the race!



🎁 Free trial is available today!



Download the free version now to create your own surfing character



⏰ The official version is coming soon!



The official version will include 4 optional characters, 10 skateboard skins, a cyclic collection of challenge levels, and Steam achievements



Follow the Steam Store page to be the first to get release dates and launch discounts!



▶️ Act now!

🌊 download a free version experience: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3390870/_Surf_Dance/

📢 Join the community: Discord ：https://discord.com/invite/3SEvRppPdE





# Wave Dancing # #Steam New tour # # Casual racing #

👉 Join now and be the prettiest baby on the crest of the wave! 🏆



🎮 For whom to play?



Parkour enthusiasts, casual players, pet control, racing game novice/master, want to relax the body and mind of the worker!

🚀 In One sentence Amway: No need to get complicated, just jump and sprint on the waves - there are easy sea breezes and heart-pounding time racing! 🌈
